findings.summary: The demonstration of behavior criterion 2 cites a command the verifier may not run: `cargo test --locked && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && git diff | grep -n "allow("`
findings.evidence: `grep` is not on the verifier role's list (cargo, git, ls); use the Read, Grep, and Glob tools to inspect files
